data['Low'].rolling(14).min()\n    data['Position_Size'] = (risk_per_trade * equity) / (2 * data['ATR'].iloc[-1])\n    return data\n\ndef strategy_logic(data):\n    data = calculate_indicators(data)\n    data = volatility_based_risk_management(data)\n    \n    buy_signals = ((data['Close'] < data['BB_Lower']) & \n                    (data['OBV'] > data['OBV'].shift(1)) & \n                    (data['Williams_R'] < -80) & \n                    (data['RSI'] < 30))\n    \n    sell_signals = ((data['Close'] > data['BB_Upper']) & \n                     (data['OBV'] < data['OBV'].shift(1)) & \n                     (data['Williams_R'] > -20) & \n                     (data['RSI'] > 70))\n    \n    data['Buy'] = buy_signals\n    data['Sell'] = sell_signals\n    \n    return data\n\ndef execute_strategy(ticker, start_date, end_date):\n    data = yf.download(ticker, start=start_date, end=end_date)\n    data.reset_index(inplace=True)\n    data = strategy_logic(data)\n    \n    # Generate trading signals\n    buy_points = data[data['Buy'] == True]['Close']\n    sell_points = data[data['Sell'] == True]['Close']\n    \n    # Calculate performance metrics\n    returns = data['Close'].pct_change().cumsum()\n    sharpe_ratio = returns.mean() / returns.std() * np.sqrt(252)\n    \n    return {\n        'Buy Signals': buy_points,\n        'Sell Signals': sell_points,\n        'Sharpe Ratio': sharpe_ratio\n    }\n\n# Example usage\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    ticker = 'BTC-USD'\n    start_date = '2023-01-01'\n    end_date = '2023-12-31'\n    \n    result = execute_strategy(ticker, start_date, end_date)\n    print(f'Sharpe Ratio: {result["Sharpe Ratio"]}')\n    print(f'Buy Signals: {result["Buy Signals"].shape[0]}')\n    print(f'Sell Signals: {result["Sell Signals"].shape[0]}')\n```"
